cases.description: Verify that getSchemaNode() returns the exact JsonNode that was supplied to the validator via the constructor. The validator is instantiated with a non‑null ObjectNode representing a simple schema (e.g., {"type":"string"). The returned node should be the same instance (identity equality) and contain the expected field.
Verify that getSchemaNode() correctly returns null when the validator is constructed with a null schemaNode. This ensures the method does not perform any hidden conversion or defaulting.

cases.expected: Same ArrayNode instance that was supplied to the validator (identity equality)
cases.description: Validate that getSchemaNode() returns the exact ArrayNode instance when the validator is constructed with an ArrayNode schema.

cases.expected: Same BooleanNode instance that was supplied to the validator (identity equality)
cases.description: Validate that getSchemaNode() returns the exact BooleanNode instance when the validator is constructed with a BooleanNode schema.

cases.expected: Same NumericNode instance that was supplied to the validator (identity equality)
cases.description: Validate that getSchemaNode() returns the exact NumericNode instance when the validator is constructed with a numeric schema.

cases.expected: Same NullNode instance that was supplied to the validator (identity equality)
cases.description: Validate that getSchemaNode() returns the exact NullNode instance when the validator is constructed with a null JSON schema node.

cases.expected: Returned ObjectNode contains the additional field "maxLength":5 after mutation
cases.description: Ensure that the node returned by getSchemaNode() is the same mutable instance supplied at construction. After retrieving the node, a new property ("maxLength":5) is added; a subsequent call to getSchemaNode() must reflect this mutation, confirming identity rather than a copy.

cases.expected: Same ObjectNode instance that was supplied (identity equality)
cases.description: BaseJsonValidator is abstract; this test uses a minimal concrete subclass that implements required abstract methods. The test verifies that getSchemaNode() works unchanged regardless of the suppressSubSchemaRetrieval flag and that the concrete subclass does not alter the returned node.
